race.comment: GIGGENBACH (5) has been building up a very nice record, and will be chasing a hat-trick of wins here, after a fast finishing win at Murray Bridge 3 weeks ago. She remain in the same class, and an extra 2.5kg, should not prevent her from going close to winning again. PLACO (6) never got into the race over 1400m last time out, but is much better suited to this short of trip at this stage of his prep. He has bolted in at a trial since that run, and with the blinkers on for the first time, he can make amends. TYUSIX (9) has been racing consistently, and was a close up in fourth place as the favourite in the Manangatang Cup a fortnight ago. She only carries 51kg here after a claim, and another honest effort is expected. TALISAY (10) kept up a strong late run to finish runner-up behind the top pick last start, and will meet that runner better off at the weights this time. She can turn the tables. DARKNCONFIDENTIAL (4) is peaking at the right time, and should not be overlooked. Include.
